BOOK ONE · LESSON 135

The latest report

最新消息

A story lesson about a newspaper report on actress Karen Marsh. Karen told reporters that she might retire, that she couldn't make up her mind, that she would have to ask her future husband, and that her future husband would not let her make another film. The lesson introduces the use of 'would' and 'would have to' in reported speech. The workbook drills reported-speech comprehension questions about the story and vocabulary fill-in; the grammar workbook rewrites sentences using 'said'/'told' with 'would', completes a dialogue with reported-speech words, and rewrites 'would have to' sentences in reported speech.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and then answer the question that follows. 听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

  1. 1

    Reporter

    Are you really going to retire, Miss Marsh?

    马什小姐，您真的准备退休吗？

  2. 2

    Miss Marsh

    I may. I can't make up my mind. I will have to ask my future husband. He won't let me make another film.

    有可能。我拿不定主意。我得问问我的未婚夫。他不会让我再拍电影了。

  1. 3

    Reporter

    Your future husband, Miss Marsh?

    您的未婚夫，马什小姐？

  2. 4

    Miss Marsh

    Yes. Let me introduce him to you. His name is Carlos. We're going to get married next week.

    是的。让我把他介绍给您。他叫卡洛斯。我们打算下星期结婚。

  1. 5

    Kate

    Look, Liz! Here's another report about Karen Marsh. Listen. Karen Marsh: The latest. At her London Hotel today Miss Marsh told reporters she might retire. She said she couldn't make up her mind. She said she would have to ask her future husband. She said her future husband would not let her make another film. Then she introduced us to Carlos and told us they would get married next week.

    瞧，莉兹！这里又有一篇关于卡伦·马什的报道。听着：卡伦·马什——最新消息。 今天在伦敦的旅馆里，马什小姐告诉记者她可能要退休。她说她拿不定主意。 她说她得问问她的未婚夫。她说她的未婚夫不会再让她拍电影了。 随后她向我们介绍了卡洛斯，并告诉我们他们下星期要结婚。

  1. 9

    Liz

    That's sensational news, isn't it, Kate?

    这可是轰动的新闻，对吧，凯特？

  2. 10

    Kate

    It certainly is. He'll be her sixth husband!

    当然了。他将是她的第六任丈夫！

Is Karen Marsh going to retire, do you think?

你认为卡伦·马什会退休吗？

New words & expressions 生词和短语

reporter /rɪˈpɔːtə(r)/
n. 记者
retire /rɪˈtaɪə(r)/
v. 退休
make up one's mind
phr. 拿定主意
future husband
n. phr. 未婚夫

Notes on the text 课文注释

would 在间接引语中的用法

在间接引语中，will 变为 would：She said (that) she would retire. / She told reporters (that) she might retire.

would have to

「不得不」在间接引语中用 would have to：She said that she would have to ask her future husband.

might 的用法

「可能」在间接引语中可以用 might：She told reporters that she might retire.
